text: Build an agent from a model, instructions, and tools in a few lines
quote: Building an agent with just a model, instructions, and tools is a great place to start for most developers.

text: Expand simple agents into multi-agent workflows that orchestrate agents and code execution
quote: you can use the ADK development framework to expand them into workflows, which allow you to combine and orchestrate multiple agents and code execution tasks

text: Agent can act as an MCP client to use tools from external MCP servers
quote: An ADK agent can act as an MCP client and use tools provided by external MCP servers.

text: Wrap ADK tools in an MCP server so any MCP client can access them
quote: Exposing ADK Tools via an MCP Server: How to build an MCP server that wraps ADK tools, making them accessible to any MCP client.

text: Deploy agents to Agent Runtime, a fully managed auto-scaling service on Google Cloud
quote: Agent Runtime is a fully managed auto-scaling service on Google Cloud specifically designed for deploying, managing, and scaling AI agents built with frameworks such as ADK.

text: Run agents offline/disconnected with no dependency on Google Cloud
quote: This is a good option if you prefer to run offline or disconnected, or otherwise in a system that has no connection to Google Cloud.

text: Write per-session test files for single agent-model interactions to unit test agents
quote: This approach involves creating individual test files, each representing a single, simple agent-model interaction (a session).

text: Build agents without writing code via Agent Config
quote: Agent Config: Build agents without code.

text: Tool confirmation flow lets a human approve/deny specific tool calls with custom input before execution
quote: Tool Confirmation: A tool confirmation flow (HITL) that can guard tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input.

text: Built-in development UI to test, evaluate, debug and showcase agents
quote: A built-in development UI to help you test, evaluate, debug, and showcase your agent(s).

text: Web UI supports viewing multi-agent directories or a single agent folder
quote: Web UI (supports multi-agent directories or pointing directly to a single agent folder)

text: ADK is designed with dedicated developer Skills/resources so AI coding assistants can build agents
quote: ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources

text: Agents CLI scaffolds, builds, tests, evaluates, and deploys an agent from idea to code in minutes
quote: Go from idea to coded ADK agent in minutes. Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.

text: Orchestrate agents via explicit graph-based workflows with predictable, structured execution paths
quote: Weave deterministic code with adaptive AI reasoning. Orchestrate complex tasks through structured, graph-based architectures, with explicit execution paths and predictable outcomes.

text: Automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes old turns, lazy-loads artifacts, and tracks token usage to manage context
quote: ADK automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older conversational turns, lazy-loads artifacts, and tracks token usage.

text: Deploy agents as containerized apps on Cloud Run, a managed auto-scaling compute platform
quote: Cloud Run is a managed auto-scaling compute platform on Google Cloud that enables you to run your agent as a container-based application.

text: Works with almost any generative AI model via adapters, including Gemini and locally running models
quote: ADK can work with almost any generative AI model. The framework provides easy access to Gemini as well as other leading models, and we provide adapters that let you connect with many other models and model providers, including locally runni

text: Run an agent from the terminal with `adk run path/to/my_agent`
quote: adk run path/to/my_agent

text: Workflow Runtime graph engine supports routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic and nested nodes
quote: Workflow Runtime: A graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic execution flows for agentic apps, with support for routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic nodes, human-in-the-loop, and nested workflows.

text: Task API enables structured agent-to-agent delegation with multi-turn, single-turn, and human-in-the-loop patterns
quote: Task API: Structured agent-to-agent delegation with multi-turn task mode, single-turn controlled output, mixed delegation patterns, human-in-the-loop, and task agents as workflow nodes.

text: Create custom, task-specific tools for precise control
quote: Custom tools: Create your own, task-specific tools for solving specific problems with precision and control.

text: Artifacts let agents create and manage persistent outputs (files/docs) beyond a single conversation
quote: Artifacts: Enable agents to create and manage persistent outputs like files, code, or documents that exist beyond the conversation lifecycle.

text: Callbacks hook into agent lifecycle events for logging, monitoring, or side effects without touching core logic
quote: Callbacks: Hook into specific events during an agent's execution lifecycle to add logging, monitoring, or custom side-effects without altering core agent logic.

text: Plugins integrate pre-packaged behaviors and third-party services into an agent's workflow
quote: Plugins: Integrate complex, pre-packaged behaviors and third-party services directly into your agent's workflow.

text: Manually package an agent as a container image to run in any environment that supports containers
quote: You can manually package your Agent into a container image and then run it in any environment that supports container images.

text: Offers two built-in methods to evaluate agent performance against datasets and criteria
quote: ADK offers two methods for evaluating agent performance against predefined datasets and evaluation criteria.

text: Deploy an agent with its UI to Cloud Run via `adk deploy cloud_run --with_ui`
quote: adk deploy cloud_run --with_ui <agent-folder>

text: Framework is model-agnostic and deployment-agnostic, and interoperates with other agent frameworks
quote: While optimized for Gemini, ADK is model-agnostic, deployment-agnostic, and compatible with other frameworks.
